rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a difficult task or an attempt to overcome opposition.

example.english: This competition is quite a challenge for me.
example.traditional: 呢個比賽對我嚟講係一個唔細嘅挑戰。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 bei2 coi3 deoi3 ngo5 lei4 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 m4 sai3 ge3 tiu1 zin3

rows.note: Use this colloquial verb when something proves difficult for a person.

example.english: This math problem is hard enough to challenge me.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sou3 zan1 hai6 haau2 hei2 ngo5 wo3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for challenging someone to compete or daring them to do something.

example.english: I challenge you to race me.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tiu1 zin3 nei5 tung4 ngo5 dau3 faai3

rows.note: Use this for a deliberate provocation meant to make someone do something they would otherwise avoid.

example.english: They used a challenge to say I didn't dare join, and got me to sign up right away.
example.traditional: 佢用激將法話我唔敢落場，搞到我即刻報名。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 gik1 zoeng3 faat3 waa6 ngo5 m4 gam2 lok6 coeng4 gaau2 dou2 ngo5 zik1 hak1 bou3 meng2

rows.note: Use this when challenging the truth, accuracy, or validity of a claim.

example.jyutping: zyun1 gaa1 zat1 ji4 keoi5 ge3 gong2 faat3

rows.note: Use this colloquial slang when daring or provoking someone, especially toward a confrontation or contest.

example.english: Are you trying to challenge me?
example.traditional: 你咁樣講，係咪想挑機呀？
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng2 gong2 hai6 mai6 soeng2 tiu1 gei1 aa3
